newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3966/3.3976 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3966/3.3976 to dlr.

text.p: Private sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3940 to 3.3990 bid and 3.3950 to 3.4005 offered on Tuesday in a short interbank market.

A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3966 pounds bid and 3.3976 offered. The averages compared with 3.3910 pounds bid and 3.3948 offered on Monday. One banker quoted bid only.
The average bid rate went up 1.7 percent and the average offered rate 1.2 percent on the past week.
Bankers cited declining cash inflows as the main factor behind the dollar shortage.

One banker said the flows were shrinking as trading on the stock market slowed down. Other factors were lower T-bill yields and maturing bills, which are exchanged by non-residents for dollars, the banker added.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.391758 buy and 3.396722 sell.
